title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Waiver and the Storage Unit's Own Discounts
content:
**Promotion interaction terms.** On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in contract, the waiver promotion share depends on the claimed unit's own discounts, as they stand on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement of the claimed storage unit — the storage unit whose claim the truck contract carries as its linked storage unit:

- a unit that took the first-month discount promotion takes **0.75** of the waiver amount;
- a unit without that promotion that carries the military discount takes **0.9**;
- any other unit takes the whole waiver.

## Truth table

| First-month discount promotion on the claimed unit | Military discount on the claimed unit | Share of the waiver amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.75 |
| Yes | No | 0.75 |
| No | Yes | 0.9 |
| No | No | Whole |

Only the claimed unit's own promotion and military discount are read; discounts on the renter's other units play no part.
